scope: The boot profile asks the manager to apply the display policy at sys.boot_completed=1 with the stock cmd tool; SettingsProvider accepts the write and Launcher3 keeps presenting its wallpapered home surface.

markers.setting_write: callingUid=2000 call([settings, PUT_system, screen_off_timeout, Bundle[{_user=0, value=2147483647}]]) = null

limitations: The policy command must run with the shell package identity; a native process owned by the system user has no package and crashes SettingsProvider through AppOps.
Application auto-start is configured in the same profile, but the sample activity was not resolvable when the data image carried stale package state.
The dalvik cache is shared from an earlier boot; first-boot dexopt behavior is unchanged.
